g.text: Poisson arrivals, independent exponential service, one server, infinite buffer, FCFS, and steady state λ<μ. Occupancy distribution extends beyond the
finite plotted bars. W=1/(μ−λ) includes mean service time6 minutes. The singularity near λ=μ reflects the infinite-buffer model, not a guaranteed measured
